notes.title: NEW UPDATE!!! WITH LOTS OF NEW THINGS TO DO!
notes.notes:
In this Update:

- Graphics on the menu are updated and now look way better and show more things.

- Bombs have been nerfed (sorry, The NyanCave).

- There are 15 new hats ( one for every achievement ).

- There is a super secret achievement that's sort of like a Second Quest. Once the quest has been activated, there will be a secret in each level that will unlock a portal. Once all portals have been opened you will have access to a new game mode. "SUPER DUPER MONSTER TRUCK JOUSTING!"

- Also some other minor changes that aren't important.

notes.title: Update For The Demo
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone. Currently the demo version this game has a lot of problems. I am working on an update right now. It should be ready by the end of the day (PST).

Update for the Update about the Update:
          Never Mind. I fixed all of the problems faster than I thought. The Update is comming out right now.

notes.title: New Update Is Here!
notes.notes:
The new updae has been released and with it comes a ton of new things!

There are randomly spawning power ups that give you abillitys like a giant spinning foot to knock your apponents away, or swords raining from the sky, there are classes so you can choose a weapon based on your play style, every stage now has a unique song, and finaly the graphics have been updated with fog in the rainy and desert stage.

notes.title: New Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
In 1 or 2 weeks I will be adding a great new feature to the game! Power ups! It will include 8 power ups that will be randomly put into the world while you play.

I am telling everyone this now because the update won't be ready until after the sale ends.

notes.title: Controller for The Game
notes.notes:
If you own a controller that isn't compatible with this game, there is a program called x360ce that allows you to remap any controller to act like an Xbox 360 controller. 
Here is a link to the website -> https://www.x360ce.com/

notes.title: Swingy Sword on sale for the next week! also Single player mode is now a thing!
notes.notes:
I am putting the game on sale for the week! The game will be 50% Off until Sunday, May 13th. Starting tomorrow.

Also, I recently updated the game to include a single player mode with AI for people without someone to play with. The update also includes some bug fixes that make it run much beter than before. To celabrate (And also to hopefully get anyone to buy my game).
